property.name: The Grand Azure Hotel
property.description: A luxury boutique hotel offering ocean views, exceptional dining, and tranquil amenities.

rooms.name: Deluxe Room
rooms.description: Ideal for couples or solo travelers with scenic views and premium bedding.

rooms.name: Executive Suite
rooms.description: Spacious suite designed for small groups or business travelers needing extra space.

rooms.name: Family Suite
rooms.description: Generous multi-room suite tailored for families with children.

amenities.name: Outdoor Heated Pool
amenities.description: Our heated rooftop swimming pool is open daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Towel service and loungers are complimentary.

amenities.name: Fitness Center
amenities.description: State-of-the-art 24-hour fitness center equipped with treadmills, ellipticals, free weights, and yoga mats.

amenities.name: Azure Spa & Wellness
amenities.description: Full-service spa offering massages, facials, body treatments, and access to a hydrotherapy pool. Open daily from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM.

amenities.name: Azure Bistro & Bar
amenities.description: Full-service restaurant serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Room service is available 24/7.

amenities.name: High-Speed Wi-Fi
amenities.description: Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi up to 300 Mbps is available throughout all guest rooms and public areas.

amenities.name: Valet & Self Parking
amenities.description: Valet parking is available with unlimited in-and-out privileges. Self-parking is also available.

services.name: Concierge
services.description: Our concierge desk is available 24 hours daily to assist with restaurant reservations, activity bookings, and local recommendations.

services.name: 24-Hour Front Desk
services.description: The front desk is staffed 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for check-in, check-out, and assistance.

services.name: Business Center
services.description: A quiet business center with computers, printing, and scanning services. Open 24 hours.

services.name: Laundry & Dry Cleaning
services.description: Same-day laundry service is available for a fee. Dry cleaning is picked up and returned within 24 hours.

services.name: Luggage Storage
services.description: Secure luggage storage is available at the front desk free of charge for guests with early arrivals or late departures.

services.name: Bellhop Service
services.description: Complimentary bellhop service assists with your luggage during check-in and check-out.

policies.title: Check-In and Check-Out
policies.policy: Check-in begins at 3:00 PM. Check-out is by 11:00 AM. Early check-in or late check-out is subject to availability and may incur a nominal fee of $50.

policies.title: Cancellation Policy
policies.policy: Reservations can be canceled free of charge up to 48 hours before the arrival date. Cancellations made within 48 hours will be charged for the first night's room and tax.

policies.title: Breakfast Inclusions
policies.policy: Continental breakfast is included with Executive and Family Suite bookings. For Deluxe Room bookings, breakfast can be added for $20 per person per day.

policies.title: Pet Policy
policies.policy: Pets up to 25 lbs are welcome with a one-time non-refundable cleaning fee of $75 per stay. Maximum of 2 pets per room.

policies.title: Smoking Policy
policies.policy: The Grand Azure is a 100% smoke-free property. A $250 cleaning fee applies to any smoking in guest rooms or balconies.

policies.title: Payment & Deposit
policies.policy: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, Cash, and UPI. A refundable incidentals hold of $200 USD will be authorized at check-in for incidentals and released upon final inspection at check-out.

faqs.question: What time is check-in and check-out?
faqs.answer: Check-in begins at 3:00 PM and check-out is by 11:00 AM.

faqs.question: Do you have a swimming pool?
faqs.answer: Yes, we have an outdoor heated rooftop pool open daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM.

faqs.question: Do you have an Olympic pool?
faqs.answer: No, we do not have an Olympic-sized pool. Our outdoor heated pool is 15 meters and designed for recreational swimming.

faqs.question: Is breakfast included in the room rate?
faqs.answer: Breakfast is included complimentary for Executive and Family Suites. For Deluxe Rooms, breakfast is available for $20 per guest per day.

faqs.question: Is parking available on-site?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer valet parking for $35 per night and self-parking for $25 per night.

faqs.question: What rooms are suitable for 3 people?
faqs.answer: Our Executive Suite, with a maximum occupancy of 3, and Family Suite, with a maximum occupancy of 4, both accommodate 3 guests.

faqs.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: Reservations can be canceled free of charge up to 48 hours before the arrival date. Cancellations within 48 hours are charged for the first night's room and tax.

faqs.question: Are pets allowed?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pets up to 25 lbs are welcome with a one-time non-refundable cleaning fee of $75 per stay. A maximum of 2 pets is allowed per room.

faqs.question: Is smoking allowed?
faqs.answer: No. The Grand Azure is a 100% smoke-free property. A $250 cleaning fee applies to smoking in guest rooms or balconies.

faqs.question: Is Wi-Fi available at the hotel?
faqs.answer: Yes. Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi up to 300 Mbps is available throughout guest rooms and public areas.

faqs.question: Does the hotel have a gym?
faqs.answer: Yes. The hotel has a 24-hour fitness center with treadmills, ellipticals, free weights, and yoga mats.

faqs.question: Is room service available?
faqs.answer: Yes. Room service is available 24/7 through Azure Bistro & Bar.

faqs.question: Is there a spa or wellness facility?
faqs.answer: Yes. Azure Spa & Wellness offers massages, facials, body treatments, and a hydrotherapy pool, open daily from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM. Bookings are recommended in advance.

faqs.question: What are the restaurant hours?
faqs.answer: Azure Bistro & Bar serves breakfast from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM, lunch from 12:00 PM to 3:00 PM, and dinner from 6:00 PM to 11:00 PM. Room service is available 24/7.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, Cash, and UPI. A refundable incidentals hold of $200 USD is authorized at check-in and released at check-out.

faqs.question: Is the hotel accessible for wheelchair users?
faqs.answer: Yes. The property is wheelchair accessible with accessible parking, elevators, and select accessible rooms. Hearing-impaired alert devices are available upon request.

faqs.question: Is there an airport shuttle?
faqs.answer: The hotel is 12 km from the nearest airport. Complimentary shuttle service is available for a fee of $25 per night. Valet parking is also available at $35 per night.

faqs.question: What is the minimum age for check-in?
faqs.answer: Guests must be at least 18 years old to check in. A valid photo ID is required at check-in.

faqs.question: Can children stay in the rooms?
faqs.answer: Children of all ages are welcome. Cribs are available free of charge upon request. The Family Suite and Executive Suite can accommodate extra beds for children.

faqs.question: Can I check in early?
faqs.answer: Early check-in is subject to availability and incurs a fee of $50 USD, confirmed on the day of arrival.
